content: Calibrated confidence/abstention: selective prediction with cost-aware deferral (Nature Sci Rep 2026, conformal triage). Calibration degrades under distribution shift (ECE rises ~2x OOD); if a model is overconfident in its errors the abstention mechanism never fires (alphaxiv 2603.02719). Coverage guarantee is marginal, so subgroup coverage can fail. Design implications: calibrate on held-out synthetic data, report risk-coverage not a pseudo-probability, set abstention threshold from an explicit asymmetric cost (under-triage >> over-triage), monitor deferral and per-subgroup coverage, and never let a confidence number gate a safety-critical downgrade.
